function getProduct(id){return CATALOGUE.find(p=>p.id===id)||CATALOGUE[0]}
function money(n){return `£${Number(n).toFixed(2)}`}
function getCart(){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('wjo-cart')||'[]')}catch(e){return []}}
function setCart(cart){localStorage.setItem('wjo-cart',JSON.stringify(cart))}
function addToCart(id,qty=1,size='Standard'){const cart=getCart();const found=cart.find(x=>x.id===id&&x.size===size);if(found)found.qty+=qty;else cart.push({id,qty,size});setCart(cart);location.hash='#cart';render();}
function removeFromCart(id,size='Standard'){const cart=getCart().filter(x=>!(x.id===id&&x.size===size));setCart(cart);render();}
function changeCartQty(id,size,delta){const cart=getCart();const item=cart.find(x=>x.id===id&&x.size===size);if(!item)return;item.qty=Math.max(0,Number(item.qty||1)+Number(delta||0));setCart(cart.filter(x=>x.qty>0));render();}
function cartCount(){return getCart().reduce((s,x)=>s+Number(x.qty||0),0)}
function categoryImage(cat){const map={Uniforms:'assets/instructor-master-ogden.png',Sparring:'assets/shop-sparring.jpg',Clothing:'assets/shop-clothing.jpg',Training:'assets/shop-training.jpg',Membership:'assets/shop-membership.jpg',Gifts:'assets/shop-gifts.jpg',Books:'assets/shop-books.jpg',All:'assets/shop-all.jpg'};return map[cat]||map.All;}

function normaliseSearch(v){return String(v||'').toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim()}
function compactPostcode(v){return String(v||'').toUpperCase().replace(/\s+/g,'')}
function currentFinderParams(){const p=hashParams();return {q:p.get('q')||'',programme:p.get('programme')||'',day:p.get('day')||''}}
function goToSchoolFinder(ev){if(ev)ev.preventDefault();const el=document.getElementById('cta-school-search');const q=el?el.value.trim():'';location.hash='#find-school'+(q?'?q='+encodeURIComponent(q):'')}
window.goToSchoolFinder=goToSchoolFinder;
function filterSchools(){
 const qEl=document.getElementById('school-query'), pEl=document.getElementById('school-programme'), dEl=document.getElementById('school-day');
 const q=qEl?normaliseSearch(qEl.value):''; const pq=compactPostcode(q); const programme=pEl?pEl.value:''; const day=dEl?dEl.value:'';
 return SCHOOLS.filter(s=>{
  const hay=normaliseSearch([s.name,s.town,s.region,s.postcode,s.address].join(' '));
  const qok=!q || hay.includes(q) || compactPostcode(s.postcode).includes(pq);
  const pok=!programme || s.programmes.includes(programme);
  const dok=!day || s.days.includes(day);
  return qok&&pok&&dok;
 });
}

function schoolResultCard(s){
 const progs=s.programmes.length?s.programmes.join(' • '):'Contact WJO for current programme details';
 const days=s.days.length?s.days.map(d=>d.slice(0,3)).join(' / '):'Contact';
 return `<div class="school-row-v5"><div><h3>${s.town}</h3><div class="address">${s.name}<br>${s.postcode}</div></div><div class="programmes">${progs}</div><div class="days"><span class="pill">${days}</span></div><a class="btn red" href="#school?id=${encodeURIComponent(s.id)}">VIEW</a></div>`;
}
function runSchoolSearch(){
 const results=filterSchools();const host=document.getElementById('school-results');const count=document.getElementById('school-count');
 if(count)count.textContent=`${results.length} ${results.length===1?'school':'schools'} found`;
 if(host)host.innerHTML=results.length?results.map(schoolResultCard).join(''):`<div class="school-empty"><h3>No matching schools</h3><p>Try a nearby town, the first half of your postcode, or clear a programme/day filter.</p></div>`;
}
function submitSchoolSearch(ev){if(ev)ev.preventDefault();runSchoolSearch()}
window.submitSchoolSearch=submitSchoolSearch;
function clearSchoolSearch(){['school-query','school-programme','school-day'].forEach((id,i)=>{const el=document.getElementById(id);if(el)el.value=''});runSchoolSearch()}
window.clearSchoolSearch=clearSchoolSearch;
function initSchoolFinder(){
 const p=currentFinderParams(); const q=document.getElementById('school-query'), prog=document.getElementById('school-programme'), day=document.getElementById('school-day');
 if(q)q.value=p.q;if(prog)prog.value=p.programme;if(day)day.value=p.day;
 [q,prog,day].filter(Boolean).forEach(el=>el.addEventListener(el.tagName==='INPUT'?'input':'change',runSchoolSearch));
 runSchoolSearch();
}

window.addToCart=addToCart;window.removeFromCart=removeFromCart;

<section class="v47-section soft"><div class="wrap"><div class="v47-section-heading"><div><div class="v47-eyebrow">The story behind the art</div><h2>Hear it from<br>Grand Master Ogden.</h2></div><p>Hear directly from Grand Master Jake Ogden and explore WJO stories from students and families.</p></div><div class="v47-film-grid"><div class="v47-film" id="v47-ogden-film"><button class="v47-film-poster" type="button" style="--poster:url('assets/instructor-master-ogden.png')" onclick="playV47OgdenVideo()" aria-label="Play Grand Master Ogden video"><div class="v47-play"><span class="v47-play-circle">▶</span><span class="v47-play-copy"><b>Watch on YouTube</b><span>Official WJO video • starts at 00:55</span></span></div></button></div><aside class="v47-film-copy"><div><div class="v47-eyebrow">The story behind Jado Kuin Do</div><blockquote>JADO KUIN DO COMBINES SCIENTIFIC PRINCIPLES, PRACTICAL SELF-DEFENCE AND LIFE SKILLS.</blockquote><p>The new visual system gives real people and real WJO material much more space. Video becomes editorial content rather than a small embedded box lost inside a page.</p></div><div class="v47-film-sign"><img src="assets/instructor-master-ogden.png" alt="Grand Master Ogden"><div><b>Grand Master Ogden</b><span>Featured WJO video</span></div></div></aside></div><div class="v47-film-links"><a class="v47-film-link" href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k0PL3aq-eSo" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><div><small>Official WJO story</small><b>Billy’s Story</b></div><span>↗</span></a><a class="v47-film-link" href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RlAgOido-MY" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><div><small>Official WJO story</small><b>A Parent’s View</b></div><span>↗</span></a><a class="v47-film-link" href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1w0wcMe-fRI" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><div><small>Official WJO story</small><b>Family Testimonial</b></div><span>↗</span></a></div></div></section>
<section class="v47-section light"><div class="wrap"><div class="v47-section-heading"><div><div class="v47-eyebrow">Choose your path</div><h2>One organisation.<br>Every stage.</h2></div><p>Instead of three equal cards, the programmes become large editorial stories. <a class="v47-programme" href="#super-js"><div class="v47-programme-media"><img class="v55-programme-photo" src="assets/program-superjs.png" alt="Super J's training"></div><div class="v47-programme-copy"><span class="age">AGES 3–6 • FIRST STEPS</span><h3>Super J's</h3><p>Play, movement, teamwork, concentration and five memorable animal awards — a bright, energetic first experience of martial arts.</p><span class="v47-inline-link">EXPLORE SUPER J'S <i>↗</i></span></div></a>
<a class="v47-programme" href="#confident-kidz"><div class="v47-programme-media"><img class="v55-programme-photo" src="assets/program-confidentkidz.png" alt="Confident Kidz training"></div><div class="v47-programme-copy"><span class="age">AGES 6–12 • CONFIDENCE IN ACTION</span><h3>Confident Kidz</h3><p>High-energy martial arts that develops confidence, respect, coordination and practical self-defence while keeping training fun.</p><span class="v47-inline-link">EXPLORE CONFIDENT KIDZ <i>↗</i></span></div></a>

routes.jado = () => shell(`<main>${pageHero('TRADITION.
